videos.title: Stop Using RotoBrush! Mocha Pro is Way Better
videos.description:
Still struggling with After Effects RotoBrush missing edges, failing on fast motion, or lagging your system? In this tutorial, we break down why professional VFX artists ditch default RotoBrush and use Mocha Pro for high-end rotoscoping and planar tracking.

Learn how Mocha Pro handles complex motion, saves hours of manual frame-by-frame masking, and gives you rock-solid control over your cutouts.
